{{Dialogue|Fode|Any chance Sebulba might regain his title on Malastare?|Beed|Well, with the loss of his giant Collor Pondrat Plug-F ''Mammoth'' Split-X racer, its unlikely he'll...|Sebulba|Choke on it, Beed!|attr=[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]] and Sebulba, after the Boonta Eve podrace|src=<ref name="PT">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>}}
The '''Plug-F ''Mammoth'' Split-X engine''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] engine produced by [[Collor Pondrat/Legends|Collor Pondrat]] and used around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and was still seen in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:SebulbaPodracer-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|A side view of a Plug-F ''Mammoth'']]
The Plug-F ''Mammoth'' Split-X engine was an intimidating [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] engine developed by [[Collor Pondrat/Legends|Collor Pondrat]] to favor thrust over aerodynamics. One of the first factory builds created, the ''Mammoth'' was notable for its split-X configuration, which was chem-boosted with a patented, yet illegal, [[tradium]] fuel and [[quold runium]] pressurization system that was activated with ionized [[Injectrine/Legends|injectrine]] to fuel some of the fastest and most powerful air-breathing turbine engines on the market. However, the engines were among the most fragile and temperamental to run due to the caustic and volatile tradium fuel spontaneously combusting inside them, which wore them down enough to require complete disassembly for repairs.<ref name="EV" />

Though boasting some of the largest engines on the market, the ''Mammoth'' could easily be maneuvered. A licensed [[Incom Corporation|Incom]] [[Mk .IV Starweaver|Mk. IV Starweaver]] flight control suite, equipped with maneuvering jets and advanced variable control, allowed the ''Mammoth'' to fly easily in the air, making it one of the top five best-selling factory customs for decades. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Mammoth'' declined in sales as Collor Pondrat debuted the [[Plug-2 Behemoth]] and [[Plug-G Gargantua]].<ref name="EV" />
